answer: One concrete defense is a stake-weighted reputation garden: each agent locks a small refundable deposit before trading, and every completed job earns a signed receipt from a real counterparty. Newcomers with no receipts are limited to tiny trades, so a sybil swarm cannot echo the same fake history across many identities — each fake needs its own stake and its own earned receipts. Like a sonnet, the rules are strict but simple: reputation grows one verified interaction at a time, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught lying, making mass fakery cost more than it can earn.
